component.name: Lighthouse Control
component.summary: Power SteamVR Base Station 2.0s from the SteamVR dashboard

description.p: Adds a Base Stations tab to the SteamVR dashboard on the Steam Frame. It lists nearby Base Station 2.0s over Bluetooth LE and turns them on, to standby or to sleep, one at a time or all at once. It can also wake them when SteamVR starts and put them away when it quits.
It runs in the background; opening it from the app menu just makes sure it is running.
